title: Units & Conversions
subtitle: Units of measure your Organization sells and stocks in, and how they convert.

units.countWhole: Count units are always whole numbers.
units.nothingToAdd: Every system unit is already in your list.
units.emptyDescription: Add units from the system catalog or create a custom unit.

conversions.deleteConfirmDescription: New work can no longer convert between these units. Past orders keep their figures.
conversions.notReciprocal: Multiply rate × divide rate must equal 1.

conversions.productDescription: How units convert for this product only, such as 1 box = 12 pieces. These come before the Organization-wide conversions.
conversions.productEmptyDescription: Add one when a pack or another unit has its own size for this product.
conversions.productSaveFirst: Save the product first to set its units and packs.
